page.notes: Greek readings are uncertain: "τῆς" in the line "imago τῆς boni" is hard to read; "συστολὴν τε καὶ" and the note "συστολὴ καὶ διαστολή" have abbreviated or ligatured forms, the "καὶ" in the note especially. "ὄντως" and "φαινομένως" are copied as they appear. Note texts are split across lines in the print ("Imago / Mnemoni- / ca est insita"; "Organa pro / nunciatio- / nis quinq;"), and are joined here. The position of the marginal notes relative to the lines is approximate. No catchword or signature is printed on this page.
